values: Jennison Climate-Finance Model - engine-repair review v3

The original calculation engine is available in the local project. v3 integrates the repair review into the engine, API, client disclosure and calculation workflow while keeping unsupported calibration inputs as clearly labelled prototype demonstration assumptions.
Target net emissions-price cost less reference net emissions-price cost is exposed annually; pass-through is applied once.
The API now returns yearly baseline FCFF, three pressure pillars, pre-floor and post-floor FCFF, discount factors and present values.
CFO - CapEx + after-tax interest is labelled an internally calculated unlevered-FCFF approximation; maintenance-CapEx substitution is a demo assumption.
Symmetric EV difference, EV dollar delta, floor/unapplied cost, denominator sensitivity, proxy use and ranking status are explicit.
Outputs stop at enterprise value. Equity value and share-price impact remain Not calculable until governed bridge inputs exist.
Remaining prototype demonstration assumptions - not issuer-observed
Coverage, free allocation/economic incidence and customer pass-through remain Low/Base/High demonstration assumptions.
Covered PP&E, acute scenario scaling, resilience/recovery and chronic financial conversion remain demonstration assumptions.
The common macro elasticity and the CapEx/CFO dependency transformation are demonstration assumptions.
The annual reference-FCFF growth path, ERP and terminal growth remain demonstration assumptions rather than issuer guidance.
AAPL/MSFT use a cross-issuer FEMA fallback and are EXCLUDE for ordinary issuer ranking.
Cash, net debt bridge adjustments, leases, pensions, minority interest, non-operating assets and diluted shares are not governed.
Conditional enterprise-value sensitivity for prototype demonstration; not a price target, return forecast, probability or production Climate VaR.
